decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's existing fabricated solutions for utilities and industrial applications, it faces no visible shortfall yet and would normally be retained while the market test continues.

Although more distant from the core offer, it still uses the firm's metalworking and coating capabilities and, with no clear evidence of underperformance in a growing industry, management would likely allow more time before reallocating resources.
This product is strongly related to the firm's established processing capabilities and customer base, so under uncertainty it would be kept unless results clearly fell below aspiration levels.

As an adjacent variant within the firm's core fabrication domain, it is likely to be retained because there is no observable failure signal and the firm can exploit existing know-how and certifications.
This steel variant fits the firm's materials expertise and broadening strategy, and behavioral decision making would favor continuation while performance information is still limited.
